fields.crisisExperience: Experience operating across multi-country Latin American markets with continuity-focused operational response for disruption events, guest safety, and owner/brand communication.
fields.managementPhilosophy: Operations-first leadership with owner alignment: clear accountability at the property, transparent reporting rhythms, and pragmatic decision-making that balances brand standards, guest satisfaction, and asset economics. Regional leadership is expected to adapt playbooks to local labor markets, regulatory context, and demand patterns while maintaining consistent controls and service quality.
fields.missionStatement: Deliver memorable stays and dependable operating outcomes for guests and owners by combining disciplined hotel management with Latin American market expertise—turning each destination into a well-run, brand-aligned experience.
fields.brand_soft_independent_narrative: GHL Hoteles (GHL Holding) can help if you are evaluating soft-brand affiliation, an independent-to-branded conversion, or repositioning an independent resort, you can expect help interpreting brand requirements, protecting local identity, preparing operationally for a flag transition, and understanding how distribution and loyalty may affect your operating model.
fields.differentiators:
• Deep CALA footprint with multi-country operating experience
• Multi-brand execution (international affiliations + proprietary GHL brands)
• Ability to operate across chain scales and product types (urban, resort, convention-heavy assets)\n• Institutional-style portfolio framing (rooms, destinations, collaborator base per public disclosures)
• Strong orientation toward conversions, repositioning, and ongoing operations in competitive Latin American markets
fields.companyDescription: GHL Hoteles is a Latin American hospitality operator that manages a multi-brand portfolio spanning proprietary GHL brands and international affiliations. The company supports owners and investors with end-to-end hotel operations—commercial, revenue, F&B, and property-level execution—across diverse markets in Central America, the Andean region, and the Southern Cone. GHL emphasizes scalable operating processes, brand-standard coordination, and locally relevant guest experiences while maintaining portfolio discipline across urban, resort, and mixed-demand environments.
fields.companyHistory: GHL Hoteles began operations in 1964 in Colombia (origins often traced to Popayán) and grew into one of Latin America’s leading multi-brand third-party hotel operators. Over decades the group expanded across Andean, Central American, and Southern Cone markets through proprietary brands (including GHL Collection, GHL Relax, and GHL Style) and partnerships with international chains such as Marriott, Hyatt, Sonesta, and Radisson. In 2022 Advent International announced a partnership to accelerate GHL’s regional growth. Public materials cite on the order of 60+ hotels across multiple Latin American countries — confirm current counts in diligence.
